description: Search kids' camp sessions in the Washington DC / Maryland / Virginia area by location, dates, ages, categories, and price. Location is required: pass a 5-digit ZIP code (or lat+lon, or city+state). With start_date/end_date, results are individual sessions (10 per page); without dates, results are one representative upcoming session per camp location (result_grain says which). Each result includes prices in US dollars, registration_status, data_freshness (how recently the listing was verified), and a canonical kiddinglab.com URL.

categories.description: Filter by category names. Unknown categories are ignored.

city.description: City name as an alternative location (use with state), e.g. "Arlington".

future_only.description: Only sessions that have not yet ended (default true). Set false to also include recently ended past-season programs — useful for "did they run this last year" questions.

lat.description: Latitude (use with lon instead of zip).

lon.description: Longitude (use with lat instead of zip).

max_price_usd.description: Maximum session price in US dollars.

page.description: Result page (10 results per page, max page 100).

state.description: Two-letter state code (use with city), e.g. "VA".

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code to search around. Provide zip OR lat+lon.

name: search_camps
title: Search kids' camps (DC/MD/VA area)
